en.answer: Yes, it can. In that case, you will draw 1 card, then discard it.
en.question: Can the "● Xyz:" effect of <<11735>> be activated if I have 0 cards in my hand?
en.title: Can the "● Xyz:" effect of <<11735>> be activated if I have 0 cards in my hand?

ja.answer:
できます。

その場合、ドローしたカードをそのまま、手札から捨てる事になります。
